items.title: 🚀 Open source: HackMe stack on GitHub (Apache-2.0)
items.summary: The full public pool stack is now open: node, coordinator, worker, dashboard, explorer UI, and operator scripts — licensed under Apache-2.0. Repository: github.com/jokeez/hackme. Build from source, audit security hardening, or send pull requests. Always verify release SHA256 on hackme.tech/downloads.html (official binaries only).
items.impact: Miners and auditors can review coordinator auth, hybrid signer paths, and settlement tooling. Community can spot fake pools by diffing against the official repository and checksums on hackme.tech.
items.action: ⭐ Star & clone: https://github.com/jokeez/hackme · 📥 Downloads: https://hackme.tech/downloads.html · 💬 Telegram: @hackme_tech (channel), @hackme_en (EN group), @hackme_ru (RU group) · 📋 Bitcointalk: https://bitcointalk.org/index.php?topic=5583373.0

items.title: Pool release 1.0.0-pool is live — public mining, faster dashboard, production deploy
items.summary: HackMe public pool is open for workers: coordinator on hackme.tech, hybrid signer payouts, top-pool readiness gate green (2+ workers, ~26s block cadence). Desktop dashboard is faster (non-blocking poll, earnings on a separate cadence, no UI freeze on slow canonical proxy). Wallet earnings fix: no more 502 loops on the command node; followers get canonical_peer without hanging the whole UI.
items.impact: Miners can join with HACKME_PUBLIC_AUTHORITY_BASE=https://hackme.tech, start the pool worker from the Mining tab, and accrue HMC via the coordinator path. Operators: stack deployed to production VPS with nginx TLS, settlement API, and work/stats proxy.
items.action: Join: export HACKME_PUBLIC_AUTHORITY_BASE=https://hackme.tech — open local dashboard → Mining → Start pool worker (once). Hard-refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R) after updating the node binary. Downloads: check / for release bundles; verify with PROFILE=canary BASE=https://hackme.tech bash scripts/ops/top_pool_readiness_gate.sh.

items.title: Pool ops: coordinator secret file, fleet env generator, public worker smoke
items.summary: Worker clients now resolve coordinator admin in a fixed order: COORD_ADMIN_TOKEN / HACKME_COORDINATOR_ADMIN_TOKEN / COORD_TOKEN env, then optional one-line .secrets/hackme_coordinator_admin_token (same value as VPS HACKME_COORDINATOR_ADMIN_TOKEN), then legacy shared ADMIN_TOKEN for same-token dev stacks. Added scripts/ops/run_public_worker_smoke.sh and optional RUN_PUBLIC_WORKER_SMOKE=1 in repo_final_selfcheck. Per-rig identity stays unique WORKER_ID plus HACKME_MINER_ED25519_SEED_HEX; operators scale with prepare_worker_fleet_envs.sh (manifest maps worker_id to payout address).
items.impact: Less confusion between node admin tokens and coordinator tokens (fewer 401s on /api/work/claim). CI can run a short live coordinator smoke when the gitignored coordinator secret file exists, without baking secrets into scripts.
items.action: Operators: keep coordinator admin only on the server and in operator .secrets; never commit it. Deploy site+node so news.json and binaries refresh: NODE_SSH=hackme-vps bash scripts/ops/deploy_hackme_public_stack.sh (set SKIP_NGINX=1 if the TLS vhost is frozen). After placing .secrets/hackme_coordinator_admin_token locally: PUBLIC_RO_BASE=https://hackme.tech RUN_PUBLIC_WORKER_SMOKE=1 bash scripts/ops/repo_final_selfcheck.sh. Miners: one env per machine from fleet generator or minersign -gen-seed; see README pool bullet and scripts/ops/worker.env.example.

items.title: Miner onboarding: Windows pool worker, .env autoload, release 0.1.0-rc9
items.summary: Windows dashboard worker start now launches native workerpoh.exe (release zips never shipped bash/curl loops). hackme loads .env / hackme.env beside the binary without overriding existing OS env. Dashboard defaults pool worker; API mining policy covered by tests. Bundle adds start_hackme_public_pool.bat + env.public_pool.example, Linux workerpoh binary, and opens the Mining tab by default.
items.impact: Public pool participants on Windows can run Start pool worker without WSL; operators can distribute one zip plus a short env template for HACKME_PUBLIC_AUTHORITY_BASE and HACKME_POOL_COORDINATOR_TOKEN.
items.action: Deploy web/site/assets/news.json to the site static path; upload dist/release_0.1.0-rc9/hackme_0.1.0-rc9_{windows,linux}.* + SHA256SUMS.txt + RELEASE_MANIFEST.json to Downloads; restart node/coordinator only if you also roll server binaries from the linux tarball. Telegram: operator bot unchanged — see docs/TELEGRAM_BOT.md; channel bot reposts when NEWS_FEED_URL points at the updated news.json.

items.title: Desktop Mode: Linux Launcher + Windows Scripts + First-Run Wizard
items.summary: Shipped app-like desktop operations: Linux .desktop launcher installer, Windows start/stop/status scripts, and a built-in dashboard first-run wizard for token generation and Solo/Worker quick start.
items.impact: New miners can start with fewer manual steps: local node startup, admin token bootstrap, and worker-mode onboarding are now guided in one flow.
items.action: Linux: run scripts/ops/install_linux_desktop_launcher.sh then desktop_mode_up.sh. Windows: use start_hackme_desktop_mode.bat and verify /api/status via status_hackme_desktop_mode.bat.

items.title: /api/status: Schema Always + Canonical Economics Overlay
items.summary: Follower/worker nodes now always report local SQLite schema_version for migration gates; remote canonical URL merges economics/crypto/consensus_policy from canon /api/status so fuzz_release_gate economics checks work on pool followers.
items.impact: private_stage_gate schema-version-match passes on migrated DBs; dashboards show canon-aligned policy without implying local ledger economics.
items.action: Rebuild/restart nodes; verify GET /api/status schema fields; optional ADMIN_TOKEN BASE=https://hackme.tech bash scripts/ops/run_canonical_fuzz_gate.sh when ops-approved.

items.title: Fuzz Campaigns Guide (Docs + Site)
items.summary: Added docs/FUZZ_PRODUCT_GUIDE.md and public fuzz-guide.html covering fuzz_release_gate.sh, HACKME_FUZZ_AUTORUN and artifact env, report tokens, CI gate endpoint, and housekeeping APIs.
items.impact: Operators and auditors have a single fuzz onboarding path linked from Docs, API reference, and operator checklist.
items.action: Visit /fuzz-guide.html after deploy; keep fuzz_release_gate green before tagging releases.

items.title: Operator Final Checklist (Repo + Site)
items.summary: Added docs/OPERATOR_FINAL_CHECKLIST.md and public operator-checklist.html linking predeploy/fuzz gates, deploy commands, settlement scripts, and troubleshooting flow.
items.impact: Operators have one path for pre-final verification without hunting scattered runbooks.
items.action: Open /operator-checklist.html after deploy; keep fuzz_release_gate green on release candidates.

items.title: Site Tokenomics: Order Fees vs Transfer Burns (Copy Fix)
items.summary: Home and Docs pages now match chain rules: order opening debits prepaid plus a 5% platform fee to DevFeeAddress, with a separate 10% prepaid burn tally (OrderBurnRate); the 70%/30% burn split applies to transfer fee_units only.
items.impact: Community explanations and audits align with internal/chain/order_tasks.go and economics constants — less confusion vs Ethereum-style fee wording.
items.action: Hard-refresh hackme.tech index/docs after deploy; reference docs/ECONOMICS_DASHBOARD.md §8 for formulas.

items.title: Public Economics Model (Chain · Pool · Orders)
items.summary: A dedicated site page and docs cross-links explain how PoH block credits (primary wallet on the producing node), coordinator worker accrual/settlement, and paid audit orders fit together — explicitly not classic Ethereum-style pooled block subsidy.
items.impact: Miners and partners get a single reference for expectations: block header transparency vs wallet credit path, and why fleet income follows coordinator policy.
items.action: Share economics-model.html from the Docs hub; operators keep settlement automation and dashboards as the source of truth for accrued vs settled HMC.

items.title: Release Fast-Pack PASS + Final Linux/Windows Artifacts
items.summary: Final fast-profile release validation passed end-to-end (health, ultimate quick gate, security assertions, and worker dominance), and fresh Linux/Windows binaries were rebuilt with new SHA256 checksums.
items.impact: Operators can deploy updated binaries with a deterministic release checklist and shorter, timeout-safe validation flow.
items.action: Deploy dist/release_final_20260507 binaries to VPS, publish SHA256SUMS.txt with the release post, and run post-deploy smoke checks on status/work/global metrics.

items.title: RC7 Release Pack + Hybrid Anti-Replay Hardening
items.summary: Release 0.1.0-rc7 artifacts for Linux and Windows were rebuilt with fresh checksums, while coordinator Hybrid signer received stricter anti-replay and duplicate-signed-payload protections.
items.impact: Operators can distribute updated binaries and run stronger pool-side submit validation without breaking current worker-mode staging flow.
items.action: Use dist/release_0.1.0-rc7 artifacts, keep predeploy gate with hybrid smoke enabled, and canary-enable strict signer mode before full rollout.

items.title: Auto-Settlement Timers are Live
items.summary: Systemd automation for worker payout settlement is now active with periodic settlement and healthcheck timers on the canonical VPS.
items.impact: Worker accrual can now be settled to on-chain wallet balances automatically, reducing manual intervention and payout drift.
items.action: Monitor settlement services via systemctl and journalctl; adjust MIN_SETTLE_HMC and payout mapping in /opt/hackme/.env.settlement as needed.

items.title: V3 Worker Settlement Bridge Added
items.summary: A new settlement operator script converts coordinator off-chain worker accrual into on-chain transfer payouts with nonce-safe submission and self-pay protection.
items.impact: Operators can now automate payout settlement from worker accrual counters to real wallet balances, reducing confusion between accrued and settled rewards.
items.action: Use scripts/ops/settle_worker_payouts.sh with payout mapping (or hybrid signed payout_address) and a minimum settlement threshold.

items.title: Hybrid Signer v2 Dark Launch (Safe Fallback Active)
items.summary: Coordinator now supports optional miner-signed submit payloads with ed25519 verification, replay protection, and deterministic reject reasons. Backward-compatible unsigned worker flow remains active.
items.impact: Pool operators can enable Hybrid v2 gradually without breaking existing worker clients, while gaining signer telemetry and stricter anti-abuse validation.
items.action: Enable HACKME_POOL_HYBRID_SIGNER_ENABLED=1 on coordinator, run hybrid_signer_smoke.sh, and rollout workers in phases.

items.title: Predeploy Gate Added, Canonical Ops Pass Confirmed
items.summary: A new one-command predeploy gate is now live with practical checks for test suite, canonical proxy parity, wallet source consistency, and worker-mode health. Public stack deployment completed successfully after gate pass.
items.impact: Operators can validate follower and worker readiness before rollout with a deterministic PASS/FAIL flow, reducing drift between local dashboards and canonical chain reality.
items.action: Run scripts/ops/predeploy_gate.sh before each public deployment and monitor worker-mode health and canonical parity in regular operations.

items.title: Telegram Channel Bot is Live
items.summary: Official HackMe channel automation is now active: new News entries are published directly to Telegram with status, impact, action, and deep links.
items.impact: Community updates now ship in real time without waiting for manual reposts, improving communication reliability for miners and operators.
items.action: Follow the official channel and use the News page as the source of truth for release and operations updates.
